versions.changelog:
- Rolled back SKILL.md version from 1.0.1 to 1.0.0.
- Removed three documentation and support files: clawhub-sales-copy.txt, setup-guide.md, and thumbgate-rules.md.
- No feature changes; only documentation updates and removals.
Added setup guide, sales copy, and ThumbGate rules. Added affiliate integrations.

Initial release of hvac-plumbing-dispatch-agent:

- 24/7 voice and text dispatch for HVAC & Plumbing, qualifying leads and booking appointments into ServiceTitan/Housecall Pro.
- Integrates ThumbGate to block dangerous misquotes or out-of-zone bookings.
- Triages emergencies and routes urgent cases to a human on-call.
- Enforces collection of mandatory contact information before finalizing tickets.
- Designed to capture all after-hours leads and prevent out-of-zone or incorrect service dispatches.
